# Testament of Judah — 4
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Greek MS (Codex Cantabrigiensis) | **Section:** Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs

---

**1:1** The copy of the words of Judah, which he spoke to his sons before he died.
**1:2** They gathered themselves together and came to him, and he said to them:
**1:3** Hear, my children, the words of Judah your father, and keep my sayings.
**1:4** I was the fourth son born to my father Jacob; and my mother Leah named me Judah, saying: I give thanks to the LORD.
**1:5** And I was swift in my youth, and obedient to my father in every thing.
**1:6** And I honored my mother and my mother's sister.
**1:7** And when I became a man, my father Jacob blessed me, saying: Thou shalt be a king, prospering in all things.

**2:1** And the LORD showed me favor in all my works, both in the field and in the house.
**2:2** I ran upon a lion and rescued a kid out of its mouth.
**2:3** I seized a wild boar and tore it in pieces.
**2:4** I outran a deer and caught it and prepared it for my father to eat.
**2:5** And a wild mare I overtook and tamed.
**2:6** I slew a leopard and rescued a lamb out of its paws.
**2:7** I caught a bear by its paw and hurled it down the cliff, and it was crushed.
**2:8** A lion I turned to flight by my shout in the hunt, and I seized and crushed its body.

**3:1** And a huge man I came upon at Hazor fighting against us;
**3:2** and I seized his shield and hurled him down, and he was crushed.
**3:3** I slew Achor the king, a man of giant stature, hurling his shield before him four cubits, and grasping his hand and throwing him down and killing him upon his shield.

**4:1** And before I took to wife Bathshua the Canaanitess, I had taken to wife Tamar, the virgin of Mesopotamia.
**4:2** But first my friend Hirah the Adullamite spoke well of the daughter of Bathshua to me.
**4:3** And I married her; and she bore me Er, and Onan, and Shelah; and two of them the LORD slew in their wickedness, and Shelah lived, and ye are his children.

**5:1** And after eighteen years, while my wife Bathshua was alive, I drank wine in excess with Hirah the Adullamite.
**5:2** And I saw Tamar, the widow of my son, adorned and sitting by the gate.
**5:3** For the custom of the Amorites was that they who were about to marry sat in fornication at the city gate for seven days.
**5:4** Being intoxicated with wine, I did not recognize her; and her beauty deceived me, because of the way she had adorned herself to deceive me.
**5:5** And I turned aside to her and said: Let me go in to thee. And she said: What wilt thou give me? And I gave her my staff and my girdle and the diadem of my kingdom.
**5:6** And I went in to her, and she conceived.
**5:7** And not knowing what I had done, I wished to slay her; but she secretly sent my pledges, and put me to shame.
**5:8** And when I called her to me, I heard also the secret words which I spoke when lying with her in my drunkenness; and I could not slay her, for it was from the LORD.

**6:1** For I said: Lest I also be condemned for having wished to slay her by deception, I will not again drink wine.
**6:2** And from that day I drank no wine until my old age, neither did I rejoice in any pleasant thing; for I knew that I had sinned concerning Tamar.
**6:3** For even the patriarch of my father had no pleasure in my act.
**6:4** And I ceased henceforth to drink wine and flesh for fourteen years.

**7:1** And I tell you these things, my children, that you may not fall into the snare of wine.
**7:2** For wine turns the mind away from the truth, and inspires the passion of lust, and leads the eyes into error.
**7:3** For the spirit of fornication has wine as a minister to give pleasure to the mind; for these two also take away the power of a man.
**7:4** For if a man drinks wine to drunkenness, it disturbs the mind with filthy thoughts leading to fornication, and heats the body to carnal union; and if the occasion of the lust be present, he works the sin, and is not ashamed.
**7:5** Such is the inebriated man, my children; for he who is drunken reverences no man.
**7:6** For lo, it made me also to err, so that I was not ashamed of the multitude in the city, in that before the eyes of all I turned aside to Tamar, and I wrought a great sin.

**8:1** After drinking wine I had no fear of God, and I did not remember the commandment of my father, and I went in to her.
**8:2** For those who are not drunk with wine, who have the fear of God, do not commit fornication.
**8:3** But the man who is drunk with wine honors no man; and by drunkenness the mind of many has been corrupted from the beginning.

**9:1** And now, my children, I command you: love not money, nor gaze on the beauty of women; because for the sake of money and beauty I was led astray to Bathshua the Canaanitess.
**9:2** For I know that my seed shall go into captivity through these two things.
**9:3** For even the wise men among my sons shall they make to err, and shall cause the kingdom of Judah to be diminished, which the LORD gave me because of my obedience to my father.
**9:4** For I never caused grief to my father Jacob; for all things whatsoever he commanded me I did.
**9:5** And Isaac the father of my father blessed me to be king in Israel, and Jacob further blessed me in like manner.

**10:1** And I know that from me shall the kingdom be established.
**10:2** And I have read in the books of Enoch the righteous how great evils ye will do in the last days.
**10:3** Take heed therefore, my children, of fornication, and the love of money, and hearken to Judah your father.
**10:4** For these things withdraw you from the law of God, and blind the inclination of the soul, and teach arrogance, and suffer not a man to have compassion upon his neighbor.
**10:5** They rob his soul of all goodness, and oppress him with toils and troubles, and drive away sleep from him, and devour his flesh.
**10:6** And he hinders the sacrifices of God; and he remembers not the blessing of God, and hearkens not to a prophet when he speaks, and resents the words of godliness.
**10:7** For he is enslaved to two contrary passions, and cannot obey God, because they have blinded his soul, and he walks in the day as in the night.

**11:1** But keep the commandments of the LORD, my children, and honor Levi, that ye may dwell in safety.
**11:2** For the salvation of Israel shall arise from the tribe of Judah and of Levi; the LORD shall appear among men, saving every race of Israel.
**11:3** For the LORD shall bless Levi, and Judah's people shall be glorified.
**11:4** For the LORD shall raise up from Levi as it were a High Priest, and from Judah as it were a King, God and man; he shall save all the nations and the race of Israel.

---
*End of Testament of Judah*
